Optimizer plan hierarchy
When the Optimizer optimizes a set of shipments, it works within a hierarchy of information. The
hierarchy includes:
l Plan: A set of trips and loads generated by the Optimizer using shipment, location, carrier rate, and
hub information. A plan represents a picture of the entire scenario for a period.
l Web: A set of dependent trips and loads. These trips and loads are dependent on each other due to

Chapter 5. Configuration Files
Chapter 5. Configuration Files
Most of the configuration details for Transportation Planner are stored in the configuration file
tpConfig.xml.
By default this file is located in the C:\by\tp\<2025.4.0.0>\config or
/opt/by/tp/<2025.4.0.0>/config folder.
Many of the configuration parameters in the configuration file contain Basic and Advanced sections. The
average user can manually set the Basic parameters. Experienced users can modify Advanced
parameters.

Chapter 2. Transportation Planner strategies
Chapter 2. Transportation Planner strategies
The strategy file
The Optimizer uses a text file to determine how shipments will be optimized. Each line of the file
specifies an available function and each function can have arguments that control the behavior of the
function. For more information, see Arguments and functions. The strategy file name is configurable.
The file ending is typically ".strat".
